card_config.value: CODE GEASS Lelouch of the Rebellion
Add this card to your hand, or if you have the required energy, perform Raid with it.
Order of the Black Knights / Chinese Federation / KMF

card_set: Booster Pack CODE GEASS Lelouch of the Rebellion Vol.2 [UEX03BT]
card_text:
#If on the Front Line# At the end of your attack phase, sideline this character or place one card from your hand into your sideline.
【Raid】 <Li Xingke> Switch to active. May move to the front line.
【Impact (1)】 (When this character attacks and wins a battle, deal 1 damage to your opponent.)
[When Played] Choose up to one character with 3500 or less BP on your opponent's front line and return it to their hand. Choose up to one <Tianzi> on your energy line and switch it to active.

regulations.title: One Battle Rule CODE GEASS: Lelouch of the Rebellion
